Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Greets!

Sennadurek's special triggers only when the Edge is lost due to a bleed action or it works during a referednum as well if the edge is burned?

Name: Sennadurek
[LoB:U]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Nagaraja
Group: 4
Capacity: 6
Discipline: dom AUS NEC
Sabbat. Black Hand: Whenever a Methuselah loses the Edge when it is not your turn, Sennadurek untaps, and you may look at that Methuselah's hand. Scarce.
Artist: Andrew Trabbold

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
Yes, Sennadurek untaps then as well. Her cardtext does not limit the occasion when/how the edge is lost. E.g. when you're burning the Edge to untap Emily Carson.

See also  LSJ-20121225
